topics.name: Agent reliability, security, and coordination
topics.summary: These papers study tool-using and multi-agent reliability using memory, GUI, security, and recovery benchmarks; analyses find that structured state and adversarial testing expose safer execution paths.

topics.name: Multimodal reasoning and foundation-model evaluation
topics.summary: These papers study visual, language, chart, spatial, and financial reasoning using altered prompts, scientific images, and budgeted evaluations; analyses find that evidence use and protocol choice matter as much as model scale.

topics.name: Efficient inference, compression, and serving
topics.summary: These papers study latency, memory, bandwidth, and privacy-efficient inference using video, speech, diffusion, language, and edge workloads; analyses find that quantization, caching, and hardware-aware serving preserve useful quality.

topics.name: Alignment, post-training, and preference learning
topics.summary: These papers study preference optimization, feedback learning, and safety tuning using shopping, dialogue, medical, recommendation, and multimodal tasks; analyses find that targeted rewards help, but reward hacking and context blindness persist.

topics.name: Persistent memory and long-context agents
topics.summary: These papers study retention, routing, and governance of information across sessions using long-context benchmarks and recurrent memory architectures; analyses find that lineage and task-relevant selection determine whether memory helps reasoning.

topics.name: Medical imaging and clinical AI
topics.summary: These papers study anatomy-aware clinical modeling and medical image analysis using CT, MRI, ultrasound, histology, and radiology data; analyses find that structure and uncertainty improve results while deployment shift remains difficult.

topics.name: Distillation and teacher-student transfer
topics.summary: These papers study teacher-student transfer for reasoning, speech, vision, and PDEs using paired model outputs and efficiency benchmarks; analyses find that supervision placement and calibration matter as much as teacher strength.

topics.name: Attention, caching, and model efficiency
topics.summary: These papers study attention routing, cache management, and token selection using long-context, video, and hardware profiling experiments; analyses find that removing redundant computation improves throughput but can destabilize quality.

topics.name: Visual detection and recognition
topics.summary: These papers study open-vocabulary detection, anomaly recognition, and visual affect using image, video, biomedical, and object datasets; analyses find that multi-scale and relational features improve robustness across conditions.

topics.name: Geometric vision and mathematical representations
topics.summary: These papers study geometric transforms, splatting, reconstruction, and manifold operators using sparse views, floorplans, and non-Euclidean learning problems; analyses find that explicit invariance stabilizes prediction under missing or moving observations.

topics.name: Autonomous driving and vehicle safety
topics.summary: These papers study driving world models, trajectories, and safety validation using simulation, road data, and risk-oriented protocols; analyses find that geometry and counterfactual testing are needed for credible safety claims.

topics.name: Sequential decision and control methods
topics.summary: These papers study reinforcement learning, diffusion policies, bandits, and trajectory optimization using robotics, games, resource allocation, and contact tasks; analyses find that reward design and dynamics constraints matter beyond one nominal rollout.

topics.name: Time-series forecasting and monitoring
topics.summary: These papers study finance, weather, air quality, and anomaly forecasting using irregular, missing, and regime-changing time series; analyses find that multimodal encoders help, but calibration and transfer determine practical value.

topics.name: Optimization and statistical learning theory
topics.summary: These papers study kernels, bandits, smoothing, constraints, and training theory using formal analyses and controlled numerical experiments; analyses find that rates, regret, and failure modes guide practical algorithm design.

topics.name: Numerical algorithms and scalable solvers
topics.summary: These papers study structured linear algebra, root finding, selection, and constrained solvers using matrix, transport, and nonlinear optimization benchmarks; analyses find that exploiting algebraic structure reduces cost without changing the solution target.

topics.name: Speech, audio, and sound generation
topics.summary: These papers study multilingual synthesis, enhancement, diarization, and audio description using public, spontaneous, and long-form recordings; analyses find that conditioning and distillation improve control while dialect coverage remains uneven.

topics.name: EEG and latent biomedical representations
topics.summary: These papers study shared latent modeling for EEG, MRI, sleep, and physiological signals using cross-subject and cross-device biomedical datasets; analyses find that temporal and anatomical structure support transfer but labels still dominate.

topics.name: Domain adaptation and transfer
topics.summary: These papers study unsupervised transfer across clinical, vehicle, and visual domains using unlabeled target data and end-to-end deployment pipelines; analyses find that alignment and pseudo-labeling help selectively under distribution shift.

topics.name: Games and interactive agents
topics.summary: These papers study interactive play, game benchmarks, and generative game design using simulated environments and player-centered studies; analyses find that exploration, social interaction, and controllable generation work together.

topics.name: Uncertainty, calibration, and selective prediction
topics.summary: These papers study abstention, calibrated confidence, and risk-aware prediction using diffusion, clinical, and stochastic prediction tasks; analyses find that coverage-aware scores outperform raw confidence under shifting inputs.

topics.name: Remote sensing and geospatial learning
topics.summary: These papers study satellite, radar, ice, biomass, and mapping analysis using remote-sensing imagery and spatial-temporal field data; analyses find that alignment and lightweight calibration improve transfer across environments.

topics.name: Information retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation
topics.summary: These papers study multi-hop retrieval, SQL, recommendations, and evidence compression using structured indices and query-time adaptation benchmarks; analyses find that source selection and grounding matter more than context length alone.

topics.name: LLM judges and evaluation methodology
topics.summary: These papers study rubric compilation, judge robustness, and adaptive scoring using paraphrase, silence, budget, and adversarial evaluation sets; analyses find that typed criteria and measurement design reduce unstable rankings.

topics.name: Fuzzy, rule-based, and neuro-symbolic learning
topics.summary: These papers study fuzzy inference, logic, hyperbolic rules, and compliance reasoning using symbolic tasks and clinical process data; analyses find that explicit constraints improve interpretability but ontology coverage limits scale.

topics.name: Distribution modeling and generative processes
topics.summary: These papers study extreme-value, stochastic, diffusion, and transport modeling using simulations with tails, attacks, and uncertain dynamics; analyses find that distributional control improves robustness when support assumptions hold.

topics.name: Hyperspectral image analysis
topics.summary: These papers study spectral-spatial classification and freshness estimation using small hyperspectral agricultural datasets; analyses find that lightweight and ordinal objectives provide practical gains under acquisition variation.

topics.name: Mixture-of-experts language models
topics.summary: These papers study expert routing, placement, and memory-efficient MoE serving using language, market, and reinforcement-learning workloads; analyses find that dynamic selection improves utilization but specialization drift needs monitoring.

topics.name: Reflective agents and video representations
topics.summary: These papers study causal video representations and reflective action agents using video generation and interactive planning benchmarks; analyses find that temporal features help planning when visual fidelity is separated from interaction.

topics.name: Machine translation and multilingual NLP
topics.summary: These papers study cross-lingual tools, entity grounding, and dialect transfer using multilingual APIs, translation corpora, and low-resource data; analyses find that retrieval and targeted post-training improve semantic preservation.

topics.name: Robust vector and margin-based classification
topics.summary: These papers study support-vector, prototype, and uncertainty-aware classification using noisy and shifted vector datasets; analyses find that geometric regularization improves separation and calibration.

topics.name: Hand pose and gesture analysis
topics.summary: These papers study hand visibility, pose estimation, and gesture interaction using AR, browser, and robotic sensing data; analyses find that keypoint-aware models support real-time use despite occlusion.

topics.name: Robotic manipulation and visual editing
topics.summary: These papers study visual control, dexterous manipulation, and robot-oriented editing using human demonstrations, object images, and sim-to-real tests; analyses find that geometry and action conditioning improve target preservation.

topics.name: Radar sensing and geospatial perception
topics.summary: These papers study radar, aerial imagery, and weather-robust perception using air-traffic and remote-sensing observations; analyses find that physical signal cues complement semantic visual representations.

topics.name: Enterprise retrieval and organizational AI
topics.summary: These papers study internal-document retrieval and organizational AI workflows using enterprise benchmarks, adoption evidence, and structured reports; analyses find that instruction adherence and governance can dominate model accuracy.

topics.name: Audio understanding and generation
topics.summary: These papers study infant speech, sound scenes, and conditioned audio generation using speaker-aware recordings and temporal sound data; analyses find that context, identity, and alignment determine useful output.

topics.name: Social and human-centered AI
topics.summary: These papers study workforce readiness, persuasion, accessibility, and online communities using surveys, interaction logs, and social datasets; analyses find that agency, fairness, and institutional setting shape adoption.

topics.name: Efficient speech and constrained language decoding
topics.summary: These papers study speculative, codec, distilled, and automata-based decoding using speech, multilingual, and finite-set generation tasks; analyses find that speedups are useful only when validity and language behavior survive.

topics.name: Outdoor robot navigation
topics.summary: These papers study maritime, UAV, and vision-language navigation using changing geometry, weather, and continuous-action environments; analyses find that curricula and shared policies improve robustness but not open-world transfer.

topics.name: Image cutout and segmentation
topics.summary: These papers study saliency, weak-label, plant, medical, and object segmentation using limited-annotation image datasets; analyses find that boundary quality matters alongside classification accuracy.

topics.name: Graph representation and structured prediction
topics.summary: These papers study graph learning for visualization, anomalies, recommendation, and scheduling using dynamic relational datasets and structured outputs; analyses find that relational inductive bias helps while oversmoothing and temporal shift remain.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning and circuits
topics.summary: These papers study quantum generative models, Hamiltonians, gates, and learning theory using quantum circuits and classical comparison settings; analyses find that resource counts and oracle access clarify practical quantum tradeoffs.

topics.name: Political NLP and social computing
topics.summary: These papers study political alignment, activism, migration discourse, and public stance using social-media collections and language-model audits; analyses find that framing and demographic context strongly affect conclusions.

topics.name: Automated reasoning and theorem discovery
topics.summary: These papers study conjecture generation, theorem proving, and typed formal logic using proof corpora and executable mathematical benchmarks; analyses find that retrieval and proof checking expand verification but premise selection limits coverage.

topics.name: Information-theoretic representation learning
topics.summary: These papers study continual learning, memorization, geometry, and data selection using replay buffers, model activations, and representation probes; analyses find that bounds link information loss with forgetting and generalization.

topics.name: Text representation and semantic retrieval
topics.summary: These papers study semantic compression, multilingual embeddings, attribution, and document matching using text, citation, and hosted-model outputs; analyses find that structural signals improve retrieval while shortcuts can mimic semantic gains.

topics.name: Federated and distributed learning
topics.summary: These papers study vehicular federated transfer and personalized aggregation using heterogeneous clients and communication-limited systems; analyses find that communication-aware mixing improves privacy-preserving transfer.

topics.name: Geospatial generative models
topics.summary: These papers study semantic maps, geolocation, and spatially conditioned generation using remote-sensing images and foundation-model features; analyses find that separating spatial evidence from language or pixels improves interpretation.

topics.name: Ambiguity and language uncertainty
topics.summary: These papers study consistency-based ambiguity detection and uncertain closed-loop calibration using model and feature-space perturbations plus sensor relays; analyses find that agreement checks identify when predictions should be withheld.

topics.name: Style transfer and generative personalization
topics.summary: These papers study artistic style transfer and adaptive image generation using diffusion image comparisons and latent controls; analyses find that global appearance and local structure must be optimized together.

topics.name: Monocular depth and geometric estimation
topics.summary: These papers study depth and 3D structure from monocular, thermal, and streaming views using cross-modal and calibration-sensitive vision benchmarks; analyses find that structural supervision improves sparse-scene robustness.

topics.name: On-device and physical machine learning
topics.summary: These papers study edge inference, physical computing, and hardware-aware learning using device-in-the-loop and production hardware tests; analyses find that resource savings are possible but model-hardware mismatch remains.

topics.name: Multimodal sensor fusion
topics.summary: These papers study RGB-thermal, radar, and complementary sensor perception using adverse-condition detection and spatial reasoning datasets; analyses find that prototype alignment improves fusion without erasing modality-specific cues.

topics.name: Privacy and data disclosure
topics.summary: These papers study privacy risks from persuasion, prompts, and interactive personalization using language-model and user-interaction experiments; analyses find that helpful adaptation can expose attributes or change beliefs.

topics.name: Dialectal and low-resource NLP
topics.summary: These papers study dialect preservation, multilingual ASR, and language documentation using spontaneous speech and regional-language corpora; analyses find that synthetic data and self-distillation expand coverage unevenly.

topics.name: AI-generated content detection
topics.summary: These papers study synthetic image and video detection across generator families using cross-generator, foundation-feature, and provenance evaluations; analyses find that detectors can fail sharply after generator or domain shifts.

topics.name: Change detection in remote sensing
topics.summary: These papers study open-vocabulary change detection and captioning using bitemporal remote-sensing imagery with pseudo-labels; analyses find that structured visual-language outputs help but alignment noise persists.

topics.name: Privacy-preserving model editing
topics.summary: These papers study unlearning, federated updates, and privacy-aware adaptation using multimodal and language-model editing experiments; analyses find that removing sensitive information while retaining utility remains a tradeoff.

topics.name: Position encoding and reasoning structure
topics.summary: These papers study rotary embeddings, attention structure, and branching reasoning using formal analyses and long-context model experiments; analyses find that depth and representation geometry jointly affect expressivity.

topics.name: Boolean, analogical, and discrete optimization
topics.summary: These papers study analogical inference, Boolean expressivity, and discrete search using formal proofs and structured optimization problems; analyses find that representational limits yield constructive algorithms for combinatorial tasks.

topics.name: Landmark detection and geometric vision
topics.summary: These papers study anatomical landmarks, pose geometry, and circuit-aware structure using medical scans and geometric representation tasks; analyses find that symmetry and metric priors stabilize sparse or noisy observations.
